# Shivmani Singh

> Shivmani Singh is a full stack developer from Varanasi, India. Builds web applications with React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB, and is a BCA final-year student. Works on products end to end: interface, API and database.

Website: https://www.shivmanisingh.in/

## Projects

- [JS Arena](https://hactoberfest.onrender.com): a Java practice platform with a study planner, an AI tutor and a sandboxed code runner. Source: https://github.com/Code-withAnsh/Hactober-fest
- [HackWave Dispatch](https://emergency-system-fj9i.onrender.com): an emergency dispatch prototype that finds the nearest unit, with live updates. Source: https://github.com/Code-withAnsh/Emergency-system
- [JRC Inter College](https://jrcintercollege.onrender.com): an online school portal, in Hindi and English. Source: https://github.com/shivmani967082/jrcintercollege
